notes.title: About the release date for Dark Deity 2...
notes.notes:
[h1]Dark Deity 2 officially launches in less than a month on March 24th![/h1]
[previewyoutube=Iqhrob2ruCc;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Conquer the battlefield[/h2]
Master the brand new tools at your disposal, with an array of 100 active abilities spread across 45 player classes. Tackle over 40 combat scenarios. As your team evolves, so too must your strategy. Consider the terrain, hazards of the environment, and empowered foes with deadly effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39692636/925a6995238efb200e5fe4cc529f161562fd8dc1.png[/img]
[h2]Build your Squad[/h2]
Deploy your team from 20 playable characters, customized with branching classes, rings, weapons, runes, ability upgrades, and elixirs. Every playthrough is different, with a stunning variety of builds and team compositions to go along with your story choices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39692636/e80d21cfdb326b929dbff35f62d2cf4992036dec.png[/img]
[h2]A Family Affair[/h2]
Dark Deity 2 features a fully voiced, character driven story that encircles the Sildairan family. Play as Gwyn, Riordan, and Arthur, commanding the Eternal Delegation. Discover the epic fate that their father the Grandmaster has planned - if you can make it that far.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39692636/2398687c4e92e237b1d4dd225de757d340675b0c.png[/img]
[h2]Save Verroa[/h2]
Keep your allies close and your enemies closer in a thrilling political tale. With the looming threat of the Asverelian Empire drawing near, you only have so much time. You must pick your alliances carefully, and your choices will alter the course of the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39692636/88c66854f963bc928a05b8fc7303fdbe13deaf4d.png[/img]
[h2][b]Countdown to launch[/b][/h2]
With less than a month to go til launch, there's never been a better time to [url=https://discord.gg/68ca8u2]join the discord[/url] than now. [b]Make sure to wishlist and follow the game[/b] if you haven't yet, and I'll be around in the Steam Forums as much as I can to answer any questions.


Talk soon!
-Charles Moore, Game Director & Programmer

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2446600/Dark_Deity_2/

notes.title: Dark Deity Patch 1.53 Notes
notes.notes:
1.53 - 3/17/22
Hey y’all!

Today’s a big day for us as we’re officially launching Dark Deity on Nintendo Switch, as well as bringing you all here on Steam a huge new patch! As most of you know, we’ve been hard at work on a couple of major changes (along with the Switch release) that have kept us from putting out as many patches as we had been in the past. We’re incredibly happy that we’re finally able to bring you what is by far our biggest update yet!

[previewyoutube=-ReM4C_1a5U;full][/previewyoutube]

Now onto the important things yall are really here for: The Patch Notes!

[h2]Major Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Map art for all 28 chapters has been completely redone

[*] Added shadows for all units

[*] Map UI (movement arrows/tiles, etc) has been rehauled to better fit the new art

[*] Chapter 19 has been redesigned to better match the story beat and improve gameplay (it can be quite difficult to get an entire team out unwounded, can’t wait to see y’all play it)

[*] Adjusted the spawn points in chapter 14 to take ~2-4 turns off of the level’s runtime. First several turns were generally spent moving units and doing nothing else, so we decided to just move the spawns up to a higher point to make the level feel less cumbersome off the bat (especially considering how far they move in total).

[*] Chapter 25 has been significantly reduced in size. Most players felt that this level felt like a slog, with more time than any other chapter simply moving units for multiple turns without doing anything else. We agree, so we’ve rehauled the level to have a better flow and feel more compact.

[*] Load times have been significantly reduced across the board for most computers
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Steam achievements have been fixed
[*] Significant backend changes made to Chapter 22 to reduce crashes for computers that still encountered them

[*] Various localization fixes for French
[*] Various localization fixes for Spanish
[*] Various localization fixes for German
[*] Various localization fixes for Italian
[*] Various localization fixes for Chinese
[*] Various localization fixes for Japanese
[*] Various localization fixes for Korean
[/list]

As always, thank you for everything! If you want to join our community, join our [url=https://discord.gg/Yp2f667e45]Discord [/url]or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/DarkDeityGame]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Dark Deity Patch 1.5 "Recurve" Update
notes.notes:
1.5 - 10/13/21

Hey everyone! We’ve been cooking up patch 1.5 for quite some time now, and we’re super excited to finally bring it to y’all. This represents a huge step forward for Dark Deity and our philosophy for balancing the game going forward. While we were pumping out technical patches post launch quite frequently, we were hesitant to mess with the balance and tweak things in small ways. With 1.5, that is going out the window. We’ll be treating it almost like a ‘relaunch’ of sorts, and will be keyed in to your feedback and more actively tweaking the balance to make sure the game is as fun as it possibly can be - making smaller, more frequent changes as opposed to waiting several months to have one sweeping patch like this one. Most of these gameplay changes are geared towards bringing up underperforming characters and classes while curbing some of the more easily broken builds (like Vosh’s + Guga Steak or permadodge Cia) to at the very least take significantly more effort to achieve. The game is now in some ways more difficult, but we’re also providing the player with a wider range of viable builds to deal with that new difficulty. Our biggest goal with Dark Deity was to provide a class and build system that was endless fun to toy around with, and patch 1.5 is a big step towards realizing that. We’re also welcoming a host of new languages to the game, and we can’t wait to see how all those who were holding off ‘til they could play in their native language like it.

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
-Added Chinese language support
-Added Japanese language support
-Added Korean language support
-Added French language support
-Added Italian language support
-Added Spanish language support
-Added German language support


[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
-typo fixes
-graphical changes that should increase compatibility with older computers

[h2]Balance:[/h2]
General
Complete rework of dodge and accuracy
Combat interactions are now easier to ‘eyeball’ without opening a pre-combat panel
Extremely high dodge is now more difficult to attain
Gold bonus for clearing chapters faster has been reworked to decay slower and offer a higher bonus
Every 3 turns, 25% bonus will be lost from the total 200% possible bonus
Item sale price percentage has been decreased from 80% to 65%
Utility skills now grant xp, similar to heal
Experience now has a sharper cutoff as level increases comparative to enemy level, and a sharper increase as level decreases comparative to enemy level. (Intent here is to make it easier for units to catch up to the party, and harder for units to outpace)


[h3]Characters[/h3]
Elias
Defense aptitude raised to 45% from 35%
Fortitude aptitude raised to 35% from 20%
Proc chance on passive skill changed from 8% to 10%
Aurima
Speed aptitude raised to 30% from 20%
Alexa
Strength aptitude raised to 40% from 25%
Fortitude aptitude lowered to 10% from 15%
Sara
Speed aptitude raised to 35% from 25%

Samara
Strength aptitude raised to 35% from 25%
Magic aptitude raised to 35% from 30%

Benji
Fortitude aptitude raised to 30% from 15%
Dexterity aptitude raised to 30% from 25%

Maeve
Speed raised to 45% from 35%


[h3]Classes[/h3]
General
Lifesteal skills heal % lowered to 20% from 33%


[b]Warrior Tree[/b]

The Knight has suffered, falling behind for most of the warriors in pretty much every case. We’re more strictly pushing it towards its niche - high health and big hits to keep it fighting and on the frontlines. The Champion, similar to the barbarian, suffers from having one of the worst utility skills in the game and a lackluster primary skill, so we are buffing Heroic Might considerably to fit the class fantasy better.
Knight
Strength Aptitude raised to 50% from 45%
Mastery Aptitude raised to 50% from 35%
Sturdy: +35% health (was 20%)
Champion
Cannot Double. True Speed adds to Power (2.5x True Speed added) (was 1x)

The barbarian’s utility skill that improves push has really held them back from the combat utility that you would expect from a Barbarian, so we are giving a hefty buff to their primary skill, Savage, to bring their unique flavor more to the forefront. The Berserker, which was already potent with other class combinations, will not be receiving changes.

[b]Barbarian[/b]
Savage: Attacks ignore 50% of defense (was 20%)
Speed Aptitude raised to 50% (was 45%)
Dexterity Aptitude raised to 35% (was 30%)


The Defender and Sentinel already have a healthy place in the balance, which will be helped significantly by the dodge/accuracy changes. The only change here is to tool them more towards physical defense and high HP to help them cope with the upcoming changes.

[b]Defender[/b]
HP Aptitude raised to 50% from 30%
Fortitude Aptitude lowered to 30% from 45%
Defense Aptitude raised to 60% from 45%
Sentinel
HP Aptitude raised to 50% from 30%

The Dragoon has occupied a pretty overpowered role with the Darmena’s Kiss aspect which is receiving its own nerf, but outside of that strategy, the Dragoon was not fantastic. We are aiming to increase it’s consistency and keep it in a place where it is actually viable outside of Dragoon->Dragon Knight->Darmena’s Kiss. Like the Dragoon, the Dragon Knight benefitted greatly from Darmenas - so we won’t be changing it outside of the nerf to the aspect and Dragoon, which bring it down quite a bit as is.

[b]Dragoon[/b]
Strength Aptitude raised to 30% from 20%
Fortitude Aptitude raised to 45% from 25%
Mastery Aptitude reduced to 20% from 30%
Deft Strike: Gain 2.5% crit for each tile moved in the turn (was 4%)



[b]Ranger Tree[/b]
[b]Sniper[/b]
The Sniper can now attack from 3 range without being countered! (Long time coming, I know)

The Witch Hunter and Green Knight were intended to fit a very particular role of mobile tank/mage killer, and they sort of turned out just feeling bad for the most part in that role. They are both not quite tanky enough and not quite damaging enough to be phenomenal in either role. We will be buffing up their mage killing abilities to better fit the class fantasy. We will also be significantly buffing their support ability to increase the utility of Haste and the frequency of situations it can be used in.

[b]Witch Hunter[/b]
Silencing Shot: Power is increased by 50% against magic users and hybrids (was 30%)
Stand Together: Haste grants +40% defense while active. (was 20%)
Strength Aptitude increased to 35% from 30%
HP aptitude increased to 50% from 35%
Green Knight
Forester’s Blessing: Haste grants 40% fortitude while active. (was 20%)
HP aptitude increased to 50% from 35%

The Drifter was very capable of performing well, but it needed to be babied excessively for a majority of the game, just to bring it up to par with easier options. Higher strength fits the class fantasy better and should make this line a more capable early-mid game option.

[b]Drifter[/b]
Strength Aptitude raised to 40% from 20%
Outlaw
Strength Aptitude raised to 40% from 25%



[b]Rogue Tree[/b]
The rogue tree more than any of the others will be somewhat of a ‘wait and see’ to see how they respond to the accuracy/dodge changes. Since dodge was king and this made Rogues extremely strong, changes will be less here than for some of the other classes. If they end up still too strong or too weak, we will keep an eye on that and make more changes. Disarm now benefiting from exp gain will also help the rogue’s utility quite a bit.

The Stalker’s guaranteed kills via ‘Cruel Efficiency’ can be extremely potent, but with high damage values across the board it was simply too infrequent at 20%. We’re raising that percentage to keep Stalker builds relevant among other buffs.

[b]Stalker[/b]
Cruel Efficiency: Guaranteed to hit enemies below 40% health (was 20%)

The Thief and Trickster are fitting their niche nicely, and won’t be getting any changes (the exp gain from disarm benefits this branch most)

The Raider, Slayer, and Duelist are also around where we want them to be at this time. If they appear to be too strong or weak in this upcoming patch, we will make appropriate changes.

The Gladiator’s skills both became underwhelming compared to other T3 classes, and they aren’t tanky enough with the accuracy changes for the 20% heal to be enough. Their niche is to get flashy solo kills via crit and build off of them, making them a strong enemy phase unit.

[b]Gladiator[/b]
Thumbs Down: Gain +30% power for a turn after killing an enemy (was 20%)
Flourish: Heal 40% HP after a crit (was 20%)

[b]Cleric Tree[/b]
We’re leaving the mage tree untouched outside of the lifesteal changes to the Acolyte and a small inquisitor buff, as we feel it is in a good place. The Hammer and Holy weapon trees will be seeing some buffs which will help with accuracy issues.
Inquisitor
Inquisition: Power increased by 40% of enemy’s magic stat (was 30%)

[b]Mage Tree[/b]
We’re leaving the mage tree untouched outside of the lifesteal changes to the Conjurer, as we feel it is in a good place.

[b]Adept Tree[/b]
[b]Adept[/b]
Magic aptitude raised to 40% from 30%
Strength aptitude raised to 40% from 30%

The adept tree lacks a reliable magic tanking option, and with the Blaze and Firelord sitting in a bit of no man’s land not really fulfilling their ‘nuker’ role as intended, we are reworking their stats to build into more of a hybrid damage dealer/magic tank - opening up more options coming out of Blaze at T2. They are also receiving buffs to their damage procs to bring them more in line with other adept classes.

[b]Blaze[/b]
Heat Flash: 33% chance to deal 1.6x damage (was 20%)
Bonfire: Kills grant +4% power (was +2%)
Raised Fortitude aptitude to 50% from 20%
Raised Dexterity aptitude to 30% from 25%
Firelord
Magmatic Flux: 33% chance to deal 2x damage (was 20%)
Raised Fortitude aptitude to 50% from 10%

With the Surge already functioning as a strong support class due to their 3 range chain (something that will become much more useful with the dodge changes), they are receiving some small aptitude bonuses to help Surges continue to function as they reach whatever T3 is chosen.

[b]Surge[/b]
Raised Magic aptitude to 40% from 35%
Raised Luck aptitude to 50% from 40%
Eye of the Storm: 35% chance to guarantee a hit and increase crit by 25% (was 25%)

Reveries needed a big boost given how poor all the adepts’ defensive capabilities are, and additional strength should allow them to compete with the gale as a good physical option heading into all 4 T2 classes. With the lowered percentage on their lifesteal and the changes to dodge, Reverie should fit more nicely into their niche in 1.5.

[b]Reverie[/b]
Strength Aptitude raised to 45% from 35%
Defense Aptitude raised to 50% from 40%
HP Aptitude raised to 45% from 35%
Speed Aptitude reduced to 10% from 15%
Astral Seeker
Cosmic Tides: 30% chance to heal for 20% max hp and bypass 25% of resistances (was 35% chance to heal for 10%)

[b]Aspects[/b]
Vosh’s Sanguination
Advanced stats increased by 10% of max HP, max bonus of 10 (was uncapped)
Darmena’s Kiss
Swaps 50% of crit and power (was 100%)

notes.title: 1 Week After Release
notes.notes:
7 days and 5 patches later, the first week of release comes to a close. 

Launching our first game has been exhilarating and terrifying in equal amounts, and we can't thank you enough for supporting us and making this time special. There may have been more bumps in the road than we were expecting, but the community that we're building right now is so unbelievably special.

It is such a gift getting to share DD with you.

There won't be a patch tonight, as I don't think I'll have the battle save ready in time, but I've been working away on it. Y'all have made it clear that this is the biggest thing you want added to the game, and I'm gonna make it happen as soon as I can. Thank you so much for your patience and for supporting us!

notes.title: Dark Deity 1.02 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey all! 
Thank you again for all the feedback you’ve been giving us to help iron out the game. Today comes with a slew of improvements and bug fixes, and I’m already hard at work on tomorrow’s patch. The team really appreciates the support you’ve shown us, and hearing you starting to talk about your late game unit builds has been so much fun. We’re trying to hit a good balance right now of fixing as much high frequency/severity issues as possible while also addressing some of the fixes that take very little time to get in - rest assured there is a lot more on my list right now and I will be continuing to push these patches out.

Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug when counterattacking with camden’s flux
[*] Further efforts taken to improve the load staggering that is causing crashes and performance issues
[*] Lowered the range that movement speed can be changed, as it was leading to desynced 'ghost' units and lots of issues and crashes when lowered. Will consider opening the range back up when we have a better read on the situation - but this should fix a pretty huge number of bugs/crashes you’re facing for now.
[*] Range of Irving's personal skill now working as intended (skill leaves units at 99 xp, is not intended to force levelups)
[*] Enemy range indicator should now properly fade when an enemy unit is killed
[*] Enemy range indicators should now always properly change when enemies move
[*] Fixed an issue where mouse location would override controller selection in base and pause menus
[*] Controllers now able to scroll through expanded enemy unit info in gameplay
[*] Bond marks should now only show up if the available unit is actually in the party
[*] Fixed an issue with multi-hit spells showing the wrong values
[*] Fixed an issue where 100% hit and crit chances had a tiny chance to miss
[*] Fixed a potential crash in the end of chapter 16
[*] Potentially fixed issue with priests occasionally dislodging from game grid
[*] ’Relentless’ will now display the correct end health value
[*] Various typo fixes
[/list]

Improvements:

[list]
[*] Added additional tutorialization in lieu of the ‘tips’ menu
[*] Speed of D-pad on map movements increased (considering a slider for this down the line)
[*] Made it so tabbing out no longer pauses the game.
[*] Added ‘enter’ as a way to advance through promotion screen
[*] Added loading text to loading screens.
[*] Added version number to main menu
[*] Updated volume balancing of Faust voice lines
[/list]

notes.title: Dark Deity 1.01 Patch Notes and Message from the Developers
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
It's been a crazy first 24 hours of a launch, and a really exciting time for us as you all finally get to play the game. I'm watching as the bug reports and suggestions come in, and am already working hard on putting out patches and will be continuing to do so. I want you all to be able to enjoy this experience as issue-free as possible, so we'll be doing our best to get it there.

I really appreciate everyone who is patiently waiting for fixes. There are a lot of issues cropping up that we simply never ran into in development, but having you all report them so diligently is a huge boon. We only have one programmer, so not every change requested may be immediate, but I'm not going to disappear on you or show up in a month with haphazard updates here. I'm going to be right here with you working on patching this thing up until it’s in a better spot. I think, now with your help and suggestions aimed at reducing clunkiness and bugs, I will be able to iron out a lot of issues really quickly.

Thank you so much to everyone who is supporting us, and I hope you're having fun with the game. To those who are experiencing issues - I see you, and I'm working on it. I'm sorry we didn't do a better job of combing through things. As you might have noticed, we've never done this before. You live and you learn, right? We will have another patch soon with more issues addressed, but here is everything included in this patch:

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with Alexa's portrait in Chapter 6.
[*] Fixed a crash when interacting with chests and rescues in chapter 4.
[*] Drifter skill 'outcast' should be working as intended now, but haven't had time to test.
[*] Extensive Efforts made to reduce load-requisites that are causing crashes on some systems -- This will be an ongoing process as we continue to patch and optimize the game, so we're unsure what percentage of affected players today's patch will help.
[*] Sophia's personal skills are now working as intended.
[*] Green Knight skill now refers to the proper ability.
[*] Typo in difficulty text fixed.
[*] Efforts taken to reduce cursor-originating crashes (most notably when in chapter 16 or with glitched units). This will be an ongoing process as we continue to patch and optimize the game, so we're unsure what percentage of affected players today's patch will help.
[*] Soft locks with tabbing through units on controller should now be resolved
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Added an indicator for double attacks in the combat window.
[*] Moved the hover tooltip to permanently reside in one spot to improve visibility.
[*] Reduced default music volume
[*] Combat window now flips sides to not cover units
[*] Added weapon changing with scroll wheel
[/list]

(update may require a Steam restart to register)

Not as much as I wanted to be able to get done today, but I wanted to get out what little I had time for.

News for updates to come within the next few days:

[list]
[*] Will be continuing to fix crashes and bugs
[*] Will be revamping the tips menu to include significantly increased tutorialization and more information on relevant systems.
[*] Planning to rework some controller support issues as feedback comes in for a better overall experience and fewer issues.
[*] Will add the ability to see stats as well as aptitudes in the promotion screen (and will try to improve visual clarity of the button there)
[*] Looking into reports of certain controllers ending unit turn unprompted
[*] Will be looking to improve the abrupt cuts in and out of combat soon
[/list]

We've always valued our community's input and will continue to do so post launch. Thank you all so much. Please don’t forget to leave your feedback in the form of a Steam review as well! And as always, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/RcTxKpzhsv]Discord [/url]to talk with the community more!

notes.title: May Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

I don't have huge blurbs to give you on our progress - we're working as hard as we can on finishing the game, and we're still on track for Q2. We're getting closer every day, and almost every area of development is just about finished and simply being tied off and polished. We're finally about to finish with bond writing for good sometime in the next two days, and then it's on to finishing up their implementation with expressions and voice lines. With 450 bond conversations, this has been an absolutely gargantuan task, but as we finish up other areas and can focus more heavily on the bonds, it's easing up. It also helps that they've also been a ton of fun to write.

We do have some pretty major pieces of progress, so just to let you know where we're at now:
[list]
[*] All combat animations are finished, including bosses. 
[*] All playable characters now have personal color palettes for their combat sprites.
[*] All backgrounds are in for both combat and story. 
[*] We're recording the final voice acting for the game this week, and it should be implemented before end of next.
[*] The maps are getting their final makeovers, but everything we're adding now is simply additional - they're all release-ready.
[*] We'll be making our final pass over level mechanics and balance next week.
[*] The only pieces of UI left to go in game are small visual upgrades to some menus.
[*] We've also been heavily improving optimization and fixing bugs throughout this time as always.
[/list]
